item.title: Mirai ni Kiss o -Kiss the Future-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: otherwise
  • 発売日: 2001-09-21
  • スコア: 6.95/10 (16 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 未来にキスを -Kiss the Future-
  • 英語名: Mirai ni Kiss o -Kiss the Future-

别名

  • Mirai ni Kiss o -Kiss the Future-

あらすじ

Due to certain circumstances, my parents are living in a foreign country, and I’m staying with my rich aunt. I’m getting pretty used to life in a new home. My old childhood friend who I’ve become estranged from, comes back into my life– her name is Asukai Kasumi. Kasumi is my aunt’s only daughter, and I used to play with her a lot. Even though we were the same age, she always called me “Onii-chan”. Seeing her now, she’s just as cute as she was back then. She’s put in the same class in school as I am, and our everyday life begins…

item.title: sense off ~a sacred story in the wind~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: otherwise
  • 発売日: 2000-08-18
  • スコア: 7.140000000000001/10 (61 人評価)
  • 日本語名: sense off a sacred story in the wind
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

The protagonist of the story, Naoya, was hospitalised after getting in a bicycle accident. During his treatment, it is found that he exhibits a number of unusual brain wave patterns, and he is asked to move into a particular Cognition Dynamics Research Laboratory to undergo further testing, along with a handful of other young people who exhibit similar characteristics. With his newfound friends, Naoya takes classes, has fun and lives peacefully in blissful ignorance of the truth behind their gathering together.
